tabs.label: Der Lebenslauf
tabs.instructions: A German CV is a table with dates on the left and what you did on the right. It is arranged in time order, usually with the most recent entry first.
text:
• seit 2023 – Mitarbeiterin im Sprachenzentrum, Berlin
  • 2020 bis 2023 – Studium der Germanistik, Universität Leipzig
  • 2012 bis 2020 – Schulbesuch in Leipzig
  • geboren am 14. April 2001 in Leipzig

tabs.label: Tipps
tabs.instructions: A few conventions are different from British CVs.
text:
• A photo was traditional, but is no longer required, and many employers prefer none.
  • Gaps in the history should be explained briefly.
  • The CV usually comes with a cover letter (Anschreiben) and copies of your certificates (Zeugnisse).
